verdict.rationale: dlt is a self-hosted/open-source library that lets users pick their own destination (any warehouse, lake, vector store, or self-hosted DB) and run pipelines anywhere Python runs, which indirectly gives users control over where data physically resides. However, there is no explicit region/residency configuration feature, and for dltHub's managed infrastructure the docs give no indication of region choice or data-residency controls. missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection settings, documentation on dltHub managed infra data locations, compliance/data-residency certifications.
